yatas tu tayor bhaktiḥ kartavyeti nānumanyate sa gurur eva |

yato balam aṣṭāṅgaṁ brahmacaryam ity asyāyam arthaḥ ||
aṣṭānāṁ grahaṇādīnām aṅgam aṣṭāṅgaṁ bhaktir evocyate |
yadi punar yathāśrutārthaḥ syāt tadā vāsovidhānam |
sati hi tasmin matiḥ prasannā bhavati ||
tathā ca balam akaluṣatvam iti bhāṣyam ||
atrāpi tarhi spaṣṭābhidhānaṁ kim arthaṁ na kṛtam ||
caśabdaḥ pūrvoktabalasya vidyamānasyāpi caritārthatvāt tac cākaluṣatvaṁ dvividhaṁ param aparaṁ ca ||
tad api dvividhaṁ parāparabhedāt yat tāvad akṣapite pāpe |
yat kṣapite niḥśeṣapāpe guhādeśaṁ gatasyātitīvrair api |
bhāṣyakṛtā tu param eva gomṛgadharmatvaṁ vyākhyātam |
sadāsmṛtyadhikṛtasya caturthaṁ balam āha dharmaś caiva |
yadā dharma evāvasthitas tadā balam ity arthaḥ ||
niṣṭhāyogayuktasya pañcamaṁ balam āha apramāda iti ||
tathā ca bhāṣyam asya tu jñānam asti yasmād āhāpramādī |
nanu ca tatra balacintā yujyate yatra tat sampādya |
atra punar mokṣaśāstre vītarāgasya niṣparigrahasya śatrava |

column3: tatra vidyā tāvac chiṣyagatā dīkṣāṅgaṁ yayā śiṣyo |
yayā tv ācāryaḥ sampūrṇāṁ dīkṣāṁ nirvartayati |
uktaṁ hi darbhāḥ punar bhasma candanaṁ sūtram eva ca |

tasyādhiṣṭhātā bhagavān maheśvaraḥ paro gurus tathā |
athavā eva iha padayoḥ pāṭhaviparyayaṁ kṛtvānyathārthaḥ |

atha kiṁ kāraṇaviśeṣair eveyaṁ dīkṣā viśiṣyate na kiṁ |
teṣāṁ samāsādīnāṁ svarūpaṁ yady api śrīmatācāryeṇa |
yadā ceyaṁ dvirūpā siddhiḥ prāpyate tadā daśa |
athavā yadā guṇair yuktas tadā sa evātathābhūtapūrvas |
satkāryavicāre cāyaṁ vistārito mayā teneha na pratanyate |
yad asvatantraṁ tat sarvakāryaṁ tasya vibhāga ucyate |
bodhasvabhāvā tu viṣayabhedāc caturdhā pañcadhā coktā ||
svarūpatas tu dvidhā vivekavṛttiḥ sāmānyavṛttiś ceti ||
tatra vivekavṛttiḥ prāyeṇopadeśavyaṅgyā na ca tatra |
anayor bhedaṣ ṭīkāntare mayā darśita neha pradarśyate ||
uktaṁ hi daivam aṣṭavidhaṁ jñeyaṁ tairyagyonaṁ ca parvam ekaṁ tu mānuṣyam etat saṁsāramaṇḍalam ||
iti nirañjanas tu trividhaḥ saṁhṛtaḥ kaivalyagato |
yatra vāco nivartante vāgviśuddhaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ ||
kṣaṇaikam api yas tatra prāpnoty ekāgratāṁ yatiḥ |
